name: startup-state-search-extracted
description: Issues #11/#17: adversarial degenerate-state settle search taken against a SWAPPABLE DUT netlist (sim/dut convention) rather than an embedded copy of the circuit -- the post-layout form of sim/startup-state-search/. bandgap_top is seeded (via .ic + uic) exactly at the degenerate zero-current state, supply already valid (DC, not ramped), startup circuit ENABLED. Proves the degenerate state is not a trap the startup circuit fails to recover from ON THE EXTRACTED NETLIST -- layout parasitics can move the startup branch's trip point even where the schematic-level design was robust, so the schematic-level result does not carry forward by itself. The startup branch's own residual supply current (that bench's iq_startup_branch_final_ua) is not measured here: it needs a series ammeter inside a bandgap_startup subcircuit instance, and a klt-extracted netlist is flat.
claim: DR-0001 (spec/decision-records/0001-bandgap-topology-selection.md) Consequences section and design/bandgap_operating_point.md section 4.2's degenerate-state existence caveat -- no-other-stable-state evidence for the startup circuit's design, re-substantiated post-layout against the parasitic-extracted netlist (#17). Not a restatement of the README.md startup-time spec line.
analyses:
let n = length(time)
let vf = v(vref)[n-1]
let iqf = -i(vsup)[n-1]*1e6
let detf = v(xtop.startup_det)[n-1]
let tol = 0.01 * abs(vf)
let lo = vf - tol
let hi = vf + tol
let idx = n-1
let inband = 1
while inband = 1 AND idx > 0
  if v(vref)[idx-1] < lo | v(vref)[idx-1] > hi
    let inband = 0
  else
    let idx = idx - 1
  end
end
let recovery_time = time[idx]

iq_total_final_ua.description: existence-proof gate: the block must reach a genuine nonzero operating current (tens of uA), not stay near the degenerate state's pA/nA-scale current (see sim/startup-disabled-control/ for what that looks like at the same seed with the startup circuit removed). 5 uA is comfortably below every corner's expected operating current and comfortably above any degenerate-state leakage level.

vref_final_v.description: sanity window, same bound as sim/bandgap-loop-smoke/ (issue #8) -- confirms the recovered state is the intended Brokaw-sum operating point, not some other spurious equilibrium; not the ratified +/-2% spec window (amp sizing is #10).

recovery_time_s.description: bonus check against the same ratified 1 ms bound as sim/startup/ -- informational for this record (whose primary claim is state-existence, not startup timing), computed with the same robust backward-scan settle definition.
